#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int solve(int n, int mod) {
    if (n <= 3) {
        return 0;
    }
    int last_ans = 17;
    int ans = 17;
    int size = (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 2 + 1;
    int inv = 1;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> record(2, std::vector<int>(size + 1, 0));
    record[0][0] = 1;
    record[0][1] = 2;
    record[0][2] = 2;
    record[0][3] = 1;
    for (int m = 4; m < n; ++m) {
        int tp_size = m * (m - 1) / 2;
        ans = (m + 1) * last_ans;
        int tp = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            tp += record[inv ^ 1][i];
            record[inv][i] = tp % mod;
        }
        for (int i = m; i <= tp_size / 2; ++i) {
            tp += record[inv ^ 1][i];
            tp -= record[inv ^ 1][i - m];
            record[inv][i] = tp % mod;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= tp_size / 2; ++i) {
            record[inv][tp_size - i] = record[inv][i];
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < tp_size; ++i) {
            int tp_inner = 0;
            int start_j = std::max(1, -tp_size + i + m + 2);
            for (int j = start_j; j <= m; ++j) {
                tp_inner += j * record[inv][m + 2 - j + i];
            }
            total += record[inv][i];
            total %= mod;
            tp_inner %= mod;
            ans += (long long)(tp_inner) * total % mod;
            ans %= mod;
        }
        last_ans = ans;
        inv ^= 1;
    }
    return ans % mod;
}

int main() {
    int n, mod;
    std::cin >> n >> mod;
    std::cout << solve(n, mod) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
